---
title: "Task 1: Exploring Data Types in R"
format: html
---

```{r}
# Task 1: Exploring Data Types in R
# Theme: Planet NovaPrime

# === 1.1. Atomic Types ===
# Creating variables describing the planet

population <- 987654.3
temperature <- 27.5
area <- 54000.2
rating <- 8.7

num_moons <- 2L
num_cities <- 12L
num_species <- 350L

has_water <- TRUE
is_inhabited <- TRUE

name <- "NovaPrime"
region <- "Andromeda Sector"
category <- "Habitable Planet"

cat("Planet", name, "is located in", region, 
    "with population", population, 
    "and average temperature", temperature, "°C.\n")

# === 1.2. Vectors ===
# Creating numeric, sequence and logical vectors

numeric_vector <- c(population, temperature, area, rating, num_moons, num_cities, num_species)
sequence_vector <- seq(10, 100, by = 5)
logical_vector <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), 10, replace = TRUE)

numeric_vector
sequence_vector
logical_vector

# === 1.3. Matrix ===
# Matrix of 3x3 with random numbers

matrix_data <- matrix(sample(-50:50, 9), nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
rownames(matrix_data) <- c("NorthZone", "CentralZone", "SouthZone")
colnames(matrix_data) <- c("Temperature", "Humidity", "Radiation")

matrix_data
rowMeans(matrix_data)
colMeans(matrix_data)

# === 1.4. List ===
# Combining all objects into one list

planet_list <- list(
  attributes = list(population, temperature, area, rating, num_moons, num_cities, num_species,
                    has_water, is_inhabited, name, region, category),
  numeric_vector = numeric_vector,
  sequence_vector = sequence_vector,
  logical_vector = logical_vector,
  matrix = matrix_data,
  description = "NovaPrime is a habitable planet in the Andromeda Sector, home to multiple intelligent species."
)

planet_list$description

# === 1.5. Factor ===
# Factor variable representing development stage

development_stage <- factor(
  c("low", "medium", "high", "medium", "high"),
  levels = c("low", "medium", "high")
)

table(development_stage)

# === 1.6. Data Frame ===
# Creating data frame describing several cities

df <- data.frame(
  city = c("Astra", "Vega", "Lunaris", "Eos", "Terralight", "Zenith"),
  population_thousands = c(150, 210, 90, 300, 250, 180),
  is_coastal = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE),
  development_stage = c("high", "medium", "low", "high", "medium", "low")
)

colnames(df) <- c("City", "Population_k", "Coastal", "Stage")

str(df)
summary(df)

# Adding new derived column
df$DensityIndex <- df$Population_k / 10
df
```
